EP09:E57 0-700 ACTION: The mother exits into the rainy twilight as Alexander pushes the door shut.
EP09:E58 0-2700 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander turning from the door, his expression deeply troubled.
EP09:E59 300-2700 ALEXANDER: "You cannot let the whole village start talking about you."
EP09:E60 2700-4700 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana placing the mortar back onto the table, unflinching.
EP09:E61 2800-4600 JULIANA: "A child's life matters more than gossip."
EP09:E62 4700-6900 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, his jaw clenched with protective anxiety.
EP09:E63 4800-6800 ALEXANDER: "Gossip has a way of becoming dangerous."
EP09:E64 6900-9000 CAMERA: Medium two-shot profile of Juliana stepping directly in front of Alexander, looking steadfastly up into his eyes.
EP09:E65 7200-9000 JULIANA: "Then we will face it together."
EP09:E66 9000-11700 CAMERA: Wide shot of an opulent gothic manor study. The Blond Nobleman sits in a velvet armchair beside a roaring fireplace, reading an open leather-bound book.
EP09:E67 9200-11700 ACTION: The Former Groom, soaked from the rain and clutching his hat, walks nervously through the double doors into the study.
EP09:E68 11700-13200 CAMERA: Medium shot framing the Blond Nobleman in the foreground as The Former Groom halts respectfully behind his chair.
EP09:E69 11800-12600 BLOND NOBLEMAN: "What is it?"
EP09:E70 13200-15400 CAMERA: Medium close-up of The Former Groom, damp dark hair plastered to his forehead.
EP09:E71 13200-15500 THE FORMER GROOM: "There is a rumor going around, my Lord."
EP09:E72 15400-17200 CAMERA: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman lowering his book, gazing across with mild annoyance.
EP09:E73 15800-16600 BLOND NOBLEMAN: "What rumor?"
EP09:E74 17200-20200 CAMERA: Close-up of The Former Groom speaking cautiously.
EP09:E75 17300-20300 THE FORMER GROOM: "About a war veteran. Some say he resembles the late Duke."
EP09:E76 20200-22400 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Blond Nobleman scoffing dismissively as he closes the book.
EP09:E77 20500-22500 BLOND NOBLEMAN: "People see ghosts whenever they want a story."
EP09:E78 22400-26200 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of The Former Groom's eyes widening with urgent dread.
EP09:E79 22700-26400 THE FORMER GROOM: "The man is said to have the same kind of scar the Duke carried after the war."
EP09:E80 26200-27400 CAMERA: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman snapping his head around, his smug expression freezing into sudden alarm.
EP09:E81 26600-27100 BLOND NOBLEMAN: "Where?"
EP09:E82 27400-29200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of The Former Groom shifting uncomfortably.
EP09:E83 27500-28800 THE FORMER GROOM: "No one seems certain."
EP09:E84 29200-31200 CAMERA: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman composing his features into cold disdain, though tension trembles beneath his tone.
EP09:E85 29400-31100 BLOND NOBLEMAN: "Then let it remain a rumor."
EP09:E86 31200-33200 CAMERA: Medium shot as The Former Groom turns and retreats silently out of the study, leaving the doors closed.
EP09:E87 33200-36400 CAMERA: Side profile shot of the Blond Nobleman seated alone before the roaring fire, staring blankly into the flames in creeping paranoia.
EP09:E88 35000-36400 BLOND NOBLEMAN: "Impossible."
